item.title: The Structure of the Tanakh — Torah, Neviim, and Ketuvim
item.description: Lesson 4: The Structure of the Tanakh — Torah, Neviim, and Ketuvim This lesson teaches the structure of the Hebrew Bible, known in Jewish tradition as the Tanakh, a name formed from the initials of its three parts. By the end you will be able to name the three parts, list the books in each part…

item.description: Lesson 5: Major Stories and Themes — Creation, Covenant, Law, and Journey This lesson traces the major stories and themes of the Hebrew Bible across its three parts.
